DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 何をなくされたのですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 借りたスキーのストック一本です。自分の持物ではないので、店にも連絡したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借用品一本の紛失と店連絡希望を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: One of the ski poles I rented. It isn't my own property, so I want to contact the shop too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you lost one rented item and want to contact the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 借りた店と時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know which shop you rented it from and when?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この店です。午前に借り、昼の休憩後に一本足りないと気づきました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 店と貸借紛失発覚時刻を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: This shop. I rented them in the morning and noticed one was missing after my lunch break.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain which shop and when you rented the poles and discovered the loss. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道具の特徴は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you know any identifying details of the equipment?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 長さと番号が貸出票にあります。色だけでは同じ物が多いです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 番号長さの貸出票を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: The length and number are on the rental slip. Many of them have the same color.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show the rental slip with the number and length. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 貸出票を担当へ見せてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please show the rental slip to the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。ここへ届けたことだけで、店への返却も済んだとは考えていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 警察届出と店への返却を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I don't assume that reporting it here also means I have returned it to the shop.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Distinguish reporting the loss to the police from returning the item to the shop. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 店にはどのように伝えますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: What will you tell the shop?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一本が手元、一本が不明と伝えます。二本ともなくしたとは言わず、対応を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 一本保管一本不明として店に相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll say I have one pole and don't know where the other is. I won't say I lost both; I'll ask what to do.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Consult the shop, explaining that you have one pole and the other is missing. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 貸出票の情報と経過を記録します。貸出店にも状態を分けてお知らせください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll record the information on your rental slip and what happened. Please also tell the rental shop the separate status of each pole.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ホテル宛のお荷物でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this a parcel addressed to a hotel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。自分より先に届けたいですが、ホテルが預かれるかはまだ聞いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 宿泊先への先送りで預り未確認と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want it to arrive before I do, but I haven't asked whether the hotel can hold it yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you want to send luggage ahead to your hotel and haven't confirmed whether it can hold it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 宿泊する予約名は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know the name the room is booked under?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: レで予約しています。荷物の宛名を友人の名前にすると、予約と合わなくなりそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約名と宛名一致の必要を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: It's booked under Le. If I address the parcel to my friend, the name may not match the reservation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain why the addressee's name needs to match the reservation name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ホテルへ受取方法を先に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check with the hotel first about how it accepts deliveries.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: そうします。到着希望日だけ書いて、必ず預かってもらえるとは考えません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ホテルの受取条件を先に聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will. I won't assume they'll definitely hold it just because I write my preferred arrival date.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will first ask about the hotel's delivery acceptance conditions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 荷物には何が入っていますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 衣類です。必要な物は自分で持ち、荷物が予定どおり届かない場合にも備えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 衣類内容と必需品手持ちを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Clothes. I'll carry essential items myself so I'm prepared if the parcel doesn't arrive as planned.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that it contains clothes and you will carry essentials yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受取条件を確認したら窓口で相談できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once you've checked the acceptance conditions, you can discuss it at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。ホテルの案内と予約名を合わせて宛名を書き、確認後に発送します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: ホテル案内と予約名を照合して発送する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll address it according to the hotel's instructions and the reservation name, then send it after checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Match the hotel's instructions and reservation name before sending the parcel. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 条件が分かりましたらお持ちください。予約名と送り先の表記を一緒に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Bring it in once you know the conditions. We'll check the reservation name and how the destination is written together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to exchange some money into different denominations?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。千円札を五枚と、百円玉を十枚にしたいです。合計を確認してからお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 希望金種枚数と合計確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I'd like five 1,000-yen notes and ten 100-yen coins. I'd like to check the total before requesting the exchange.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request the denominations and quantities you want and ask to check the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 合計は六千円です。お持ちの現金はいくらですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: That comes to 6,000 yen. How much cash do you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一万円札一枚です。全部を細かくするのではなく、六千円分だけ希望です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一万円中六千円分だけと指定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: One 10,000-yen note. I only want to exchange 6,000 yen of it, not break the whole amount into smaller denominations.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Specify that you want to exchange only 6,000 yen out of 10,000 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 利用できる両替の方法を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the staff member in charge about the exchange methods available.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。残りの四千円をどう受け取るかも、枚数で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 残額の受取枚数も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'd also like to check how many notes or coins I'll receive for the remaining 4,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the number of notes or coins you will receive for the remaining amount too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 手数料などの案内も必要ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you also need information about fees and other charges?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。両替する金額と、別にかかる費用を分けて教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 両替額と手数料を分けて質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. Please explain the amount being exchanged separately from any additional charges.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask about the exchange amount and fee separately. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll take you to the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。金種と枚数、費用が分かってから手続きを決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 金種枚数費用確認後に実施を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll decide whether to proceed once I know the denominations, quantities and charges.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Decide whether to proceed after checking the denominations, quantities and charges. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 千円札五枚と百円玉十枚のご希望として伝えます。内容を確認してからお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'll tell them you'd like five 1,000-yen notes and ten 100-yen coins. Please check the details before proceeding.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 食品の保存についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is your question about storing food?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。外は寒いので、買った弁当を車に置いて、夕方食べようと思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 寒い日に弁当を車内保存する予定を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. It's cold outside, so I was thinking of leaving the boxed meal I bought in the car and eating it this evening.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about your plan to store a boxed meal in the car on a cold day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 保存の表示は確認されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: Have you checked the storage instructions?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この表示です。外が寒くても、日が当たる車内の温度までは分かりませんね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 外気と日射の車内温度を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Here's the label. Even if it's cold outside, we don't know the temperature inside a car in the sun, do we?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish the outdoor temperature from the temperature inside a sunlit car. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 表示に合う保存方法を考えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please consider a storage method that follows the label.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。冷たい外気だけを理由に、車を冷蔵庫代わりにしないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 車を冷蔵庫代用にしないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't use the car as a refrigerator just because the outside air is cold.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you won't use the car as a substitute for a refrigerator. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: いつ食べる予定ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: When are you planning to eat it?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 六時間後です。持ち歩ける準備がないので、今買う品を変えることも考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 六時間後で保存準備なしと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: In six hours. I haven't prepared anything to store food while carrying it around, so I may choose something different to buy now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain that you will eat in six hours and haven't prepared suitable storage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 保存の条件が合う別の品を見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can look at other items with storage requirements that suit your plans.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。食べる時刻と保存表示を確認して、今日は持ち歩きやすい品を選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 喫食時刻と保存条件で別品を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please show me. I'll check when I'll eat it and the storage instructions, and choose something easy to carry around today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Choose a different item based on your eating time and its storage requirements. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: こちらの表示もご覧ください。予定と保存条件に合うか確認してお選びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please read this label too. Check whether it suits your plans and storage conditions before choosing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 休憩所をご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you using the rest area?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもの上着が濡れました。ベンチに広げて乾かしてよいか聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 濡れた上着をベンチで広げる可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My child's jacket got wet. I'd like to ask whether I can spread it out on a bench to dry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can spread a wet jacket on a bench. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ほかの方も座る場所なので、広げる場所を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: Other people sit here too, so let's check where you can spread it out.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。暖かいからといって、暖房器具へ上着を掛けることはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 暖房器具へ掛けないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I won't hang the jacket on a heater just because it's warm.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say that you won't hang it on a heater. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 濡れた物を入れる袋はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have a bag for wet items?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あります。広げられなければ袋へ入れ、座る所を濡らさないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 袋ありで席を濡らさない代替を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. If I can't spread it out, I'll put it in the bag so I don't get the seating wet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you have a bag and can use it instead to keep the seating dry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 子どもは着替えられますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 乾いた服を持っています。先に着替え、濡れた上着を乾かすために長く待たせないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 着替えを優先し乾燥待ちを長引かせないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have dry clothes. I'll have my child change first, so they don't have to wait a long time for the wet jacket to dry.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will prioritize changing clothes and avoid a long wait for drying. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの端で荷物を整理できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can organize your belongings at this end.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。着替え後に濡れた物を袋へ入れ、使った席も確認してから帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 濡れ物収納と席の状態確認後に退出する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. After the change of clothes, I'll put the wet things in the bag and check the seat we used before leaving.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Put away the wet items and check the condition of the seat before leaving. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 荷物は通路へ出さずに整理してください。席を空ける時にも周りをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15217-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please keep your belongings out of the walkway while organizing them. Check around you when leaving the seat too.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ホームのベンチに袋を置いたまま、改札を出てしまいました。取りに戻る方法を聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 改札退出後に袋を取り戻す方法を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: I left a bag on a platform bench and went out through the ticket gate. I'd like to ask how I can go back to get it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to retrieve a bag after going out through the ticket gate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい、一分ほど前です。自分で改札を逆に通ろうとはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 退出時刻と逆通行未実施を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, about a minute ago. I haven't tried to go back through the gate in the opposite direction myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain when you left and that you haven't tried to go through the gate the wrong way. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋の場所と特徴を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check the bag's location and identifying features.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 三番線の中央のベンチです。白い紙袋で、中に青い服が入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: ホーム位置と袋の特徴を述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: It's on the bench in the middle of platform 3. It's a white paper bag with blue clothes inside.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Describe the location on the platform and the bag's features. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 係が確認します。今の券はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: A staff member will check. Do you have the ticket you just used?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持っています。忘れ物の受取と、再入場の扱いを分けて確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 所持券を示し受取と再入場扱いを分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: I do. Please check the arrangements for collecting the lost item separately from those for reentering.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Show your ticket and distinguish collecting the item from the arrangements for reentry. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 見つかった場合は、受渡し方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If it's found, we'll explain how to hand it over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。ホームへ勝手に戻らず、ここで券を持って待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 係の確認と受渡し案内を待つ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I won't go back onto the platform without permission; I'll wait here with my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Wait for staff to check and explain how to collect the item. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 袋の確認を依頼しました。こちらで受渡しの案内をお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I've asked for the bag to be checked. Please wait here for instructions on collecting it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 記入の確認でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like us to check what you've written?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日付を一か所間違えました。修正液で消す前に、直し方を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 修正液使用前に日付訂正方法を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I got the date wrong in one place. Please tell me how to correct it before I erase it with correction fluid.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how to correct a date before using correction fluid. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの欄を間違えましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which field did you make the mistake in?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 住み始めた日の欄です。今日の日付を書いてしまいましたが、実際は先週です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 居住開始欄へ今日を書いた誤りを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The date I started living there. I wrote today's date, but it was actually last week.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you mistakenly wrote today's date in the residence start date field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 正しい日付を確認できる資料はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Do you have anything that can confirm the correct date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分の引越しの記録があります。提出を早くするために日付を変えるのではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 実際の引越記録を示し便宜変更でないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have my own moving records. I'm not changing the date to get the submission done sooner.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Show your actual moving record and say you aren't changing the date for convenience. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 訂正方法を担当が案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: The staff member in charge will explain how to correct it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: お願いします。新しい用紙が必要なら、ほかの欄も抜けないよう書き直します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 用紙書直しなら他欄も確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: Please do. If I need a new form, I'll rewrite it and make sure I don't leave out any other fields.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: If you need to rewrite the form, check the other fields too. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 元の用紙はまだ提出していませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Have you not submitted the original form yet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。未提出です。訂正済みの一枚を提出用にして、元の用紙と混ぜないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 未提出で最終版と旧紙を分ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: That's right, I haven't submitted it. I'll use the corrected copy for submission and keep it separate from the original form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say it hasn't been submitted and keep the final version separate from the old form. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 書いた箇所を担当へ見せてください。元の文字を消す前に方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please show the staff member the section you filled in. Let's check how to correct it before erasing the original writing.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 書類についてのお尋ねですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社に通院を伝えます。受診した時間が分かる物が必要なのか、診断内容まで必要なのか確認中です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 会社への通院報告に必要な範囲を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'll tell my company about my medical visit. I'm checking whether they need something showing the time of the visit or also need the diagnosis details.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask what information is needed to report a medical visit to your company. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 会社の指定はありますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 休んだ時間を確認したいと言われました。病名も書くようには、まだ言われていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 欠勤時間確認で病名指定はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: They said they wanted to confirm the time I was absent. They haven't asked me to include the name of the illness yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that they want to check the absence time and haven't specified an illness name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらで用意できる書類の範囲を担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check with the staff member in charge what kinds of documents we can provide.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。会社に必要な内容を確認せず、詳しい診断書を先に頼むのは避けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 詳細診断書を先に頼まず会社条件を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please do. I'd like to avoid ordering a detailed medical certificate before checking what information the company needs.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check the company's requirements before requesting a detailed medical certificate. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 提出期限はいつですか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 明後日です。発行に時間がかかる場合も会社へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 期限と発行時間への対応を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: The day after tomorrow. If issuing it takes time, I'll discuss that with my company too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain the deadline and how you will handle the time needed to issue it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 受診の記録と診断書では扱いが異なります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: A record of a medical visit and a medical certificate are handled differently.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。時間の記録でよいか会社へ聞き、必要な書類が決まったら発行を相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 受診記録と診断書を分け必要種類を決める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I'll ask my company whether a record of the time is enough, then discuss issuance once I've determined which document is needed.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish a visit record from a medical certificate and determine the required document. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へ種類と準備期間をお聞きください。提出先の指定も合わせてご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please ask the staff member in charge about the types and preparation time. Also check the requirements of the recipient.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 携帯をなくされたのですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Have you lost your mobile phone?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。位置検索では近くの建物が出ていますが、正確に誰が持っているかは分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 携帯紛失と位置検索の不確実性を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. The location search shows a nearby building, but I don't know exactly who has it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that you lost your phone and the location search is uncertain. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 表示が出た時刻は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you know when that location was displayed?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 十分前です。今も同じ所にあると断定せず、画面を保存しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 表示時刻と保存画面を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: Ten minutes ago. I saved the screen without assuming it's still in the same place now.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the display time and saved screen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 建物へは行かれましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: Have you been to the building?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: いいえ。表示だけで部屋を訪ねたり、誰かを持ち主と決めたりはしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 未訪問で他人を所持者と断定しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: No. I haven't visited any rooms or decided that someone has it based only on the display.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you haven't visited and won't assume someone has it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 携帯の特徴と最後に使った場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please describe the phone and tell me where you last used it.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 青いケースです。最後は店の前で使いました。位置表示の場所とは別に伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 実機特徴と最後の使用場所を説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: It has a blue case. I last used it in front of a shop. I'll report that separately from the location shown on the search.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Describe the phone's features and where you last used it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 資料を担当へお見せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please show the information to the staff member in charge.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。自分で取り戻しに行く前に、確認の進め方を相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自己回収前に確認手順を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'd like to discuss how to check before going to retrieve it myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask about the verification procedure before trying to retrieve it yourself. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 特徴と経過を受け付けます。位置表示は確認資料として、担当にご相談ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: We'll take the identifying details and what happened. Please discuss the location display with the staff member as supporting information.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 転居後のお荷物についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about parcels after moving?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。転送を頼んだので、今度の荷物も全部新住所へ来ると思っていました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 転送依頼で全荷物が新住所へ届くか質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Since I requested forwarding, I thought all my upcoming parcels would come to my new address too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether all parcels will arrive at your new address after requesting forwarding. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: その荷物の送り先は、すでに書かれていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Has the destination already been written on that parcel?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 相手が旧住所へ送る予定です。まだ発送したという連絡はありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧住所へ発送予定で未発送と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: The sender plans to send it to my old address. I haven't had any message saying it's been shipped yet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that it is planned for your old address and hasn't been shipped. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 発送前なら、相手へ新住所を伝えることもできます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: If it hasn't been shipped, you can also tell the sender your new address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では先に相手へ連絡します。転送の依頼だけで、どんな荷物でも変更されると考えないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 相手へ新住所連絡を優先すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I'll contact them first. I'll avoid assuming that a forwarding request changes the destination for every kind of parcel.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will prioritize telling the sender your new address. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 転送の案内はお持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Do you have the forwarding information?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: あります。対象と期間を読んで、今回の荷物にも使えるかは別に聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 転送対象期間と今回対象可否を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I'll read what it covers and the period, and ask separately whether it applies to this parcel too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check the forwarding coverage and period and whether this parcel qualifies. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 新住所の表記は確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check how your new address is written.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。部屋番号も含めて相手へ送り、旧住所の保存情報を直してもらいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 部屋番号込み新住所で相手の保存情報を更新する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I'll send it to the sender including the apartment number and ask them to update the old address they have saved.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Give the new address including the apartment number and have the sender update their saved information. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 発送前の宛名を更新し、転送の対象も担当へご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-15218-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Update the address before shipment and check with the staff member in charge about what forwarding covers.
